{"name": "luhn_sum", "code": "def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n_str = str(int(inputs['N']))
    total = 0
    # Double every 2nd digit from the right (positions 2, 4, 6, ... from right)
    # rightmost is position 1 (odd), not doubled
    for i, digit in enumerate(reversed(n_str)):
        d = int(digit)
        if (i + 1) % 2 == 0:  # every 2nd from right
            d *= 2
            if d > 9:
                d -= 9  # cast out nines (same as summing digits)
        total += d
    return float(total)
"}
